Rect.geometry: width=d0+d2*(count-2), height=d1+d3*(count-2), x+=d4*(count-2), y+=d5*(count-2), local x=0,y=-height. Negative width shifts x by width then uses abs(width).

FallingWall.contact: 0x1818476c0 checks top and side contact faces. Side hit requires signed incoming pre-velocityX>=6; reflects about face normal and applies bounciness. Calls parent HitWall with reflected vector.
